body:
## Short Description
Matadora is a progression-based magic mod for Fabric that adds mana, spell schools, ritual crafting, magical artifacts, mastery progression, bosses, and rare world structures.

## Features
- Mana and mastery progression
- 5 magic paths
- Spellbook and ritual systems
- Magical boss encounters
- Rare exploration structures
- Artifacts and build variety
- Endgame magical weapons
- Visual spell effects and projectiles

## Status
This mod is currently in alpha.
Balance, visuals, and content may change in future versions.

## Requirements
- Fabric API
- GeckoLib
- Trinkets
